verdict: Ads are running, but lead tracking is broken and intake needs fixing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Google Ads delivered 11 conversions and your Google Business Profile drove 28 calls and 106 total actions — real activity is happening. However, lead tracking is currently unmapped, so your cost per lead cannot be calculated and those results are under-reported; this is being repaired now. Separately, your CRM shows 39 open opportunities with zero booked appointments, which points to an intake gap rather than an advertising problem — contacts are coming in but not converting to scheduled jobs. Ad spend also ran at zero on 7 of the last 28 days, a pattern we are actively addressing heading into the fall season. With heating campaigns, LSA re-activation, and an intake owner all scheduled to go live by September 1, next period should reflect a more complete and accurate picture.

watch_item.issue: 39 CRM opportunities have no booked appointment, meaning interested contacts are not making it to a scheduled job — an intake leak, not an ads issue.
watch_item.fix: An intake owner is being confirmed by August 31, and the booking automation is being tested and verified this week to close that gap.
